f3_program: collection("miss_walter.stickers", "sticker", "miss_walter", source("Miss Walter has 50 gold stickers"))
observe(at("miss_walter.stickers.gold.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("Miss Walter has 50 gold stickers"))
multiple(at("miss_walter.stickers.silver.count", "current"), at("miss_walter.stickers.gold.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many silver stickers as gold stickers"))
offset(at("miss_walter.stickers.bronze.count", "current"), at("miss_walter.stickers.silver.count", "current"), -20, "count", source("20 fewer bronze stickers than silver stickers"))
collection("miss_walter.students", "student", "miss_walter", source("her 5 students"))
observe(at("miss_walter.students.count", "current"), 5, "count", source("5 students"))
partition("miss_walter.students", "miss_walter.stickers", source("give the same number of stickers to each of her 5 students"))
query("value", "miss_walter.students.member.stickers_received.count")
offset(at("kathleen.weekly_allowance.amount", "middle_school"), 8, 2, "dollar", source("her allowance was $2 more than $8"))

offset(at("kathleen.weekly_allowance.amount", "senior_year"), scale(at("kathleen.weekly_allowance.amount", "middle_school"), 2), 5, "dollar", source("her allowance was $5 more than twice her middle school allowance"))
query("percentage_change", at("kathleen.weekly_allowance.amount", "middle_school"), at("kathleen.weekly_allowance.amount", "senior_year"))
collection("school_bake_sale.cookies", "cookie", "school_bake_sale", source("make cookies for the school bake sale"))
produce("clementine_bakes", "clementine", at("school_bake_sale.cookies.count", "current"), 72, source("Clementine baked 72 cookies"))
produce("jake_bakes", "jake", at("school_bake_sale.cookies.count", "current"), scale(event_field("clementine_bakes", "quantity"), 2), source("Jake baked twice as many cookies as Clementine"))

sum_relation("school_bake_sale.cookies.jake_and_clementine.count", event_field("jake_bakes", "quantity"), event_field("clementine_bakes", "quantity"), source("Tory baked half as many cookies as Jake and Clementine combined"))

produce("tory_bakes", "tory", at("school_bake_sale.cookies.count", "current"), fraction("school_bake_sale.cookies.jake_and_clementine.count", 1, 2), source("Tory baked half as many cookies as Jake and Clementine combined"))
observe(at("school_bake_sale.cookies.sale_price", "current"), 2, "dollar_per_cookie", source("$2 each"))
remove("sell_all_cookies", "clementine_jake_and_tory", at("school_bake_sale.cookies.count", "current"), at("school_bake_sale.cookies.count", "current"), source("sell all their cookies"))
product_relation("school_bake_sale.money_made.amount", at("school_bake_sale.cookies.sale_price", "current"), event_field("sell_all_cookies", "quantity"), source("sell their cookies for $2 each"))
query("value", "school_bake_sale.money_made.amount")
collection("movie_production.movie_outputs", "company_movie_output", "johnny_tv_and_l_and_j_productions", source("the two production companies produce"))
member("movie_production.movie_outputs", "johnny_tv.movie_output", source("Johnny TV makes"))
member("movie_production.movie_outputs", "l_and_j_productions.movie_output", source("L&J Productions produces"))

percent_more(at("johnny_tv.movie_output.count", "one_year"), at("l_and_j_productions.movie_output.count", "one_year"), 25, source("Johnny TV makes 25 percent more movies than L&J Productions each year"))
observe(at("l_and_j_productions.movie_output.count", "one_year"), 220, "count", source("L&J Productions produces 220 movies in a year"))
query("sum", "movie_production.movie_outputs", "five_year")
